text:
Alex (SRE): Observing multiple multi-GPU jobs stuck in NCCL init on g5-pool-usw2-*. Pods hang at 0% GPU utilization, io timeout in logs. Anyone else seeing this?
Mei (Runtime): Yup saw 3 failures in the last hour. NCCL reports 'unreachable rank' and repeated 'send/recv error'. Jobs that use 8-way allreduce.
Sam (ML Infra): Symptoms? stack traces? vendor change? We rolled a few G5 image updates last night.
Alex (SRE): Stack shows timeouts inside ncclCommInitRank, then retries. Kernel dmesg on node-12 has mlx5_core timeouts (firmware 23.21) and ib_uverbs errors.
Jordan (Network): Could be RoCE path issue. Any MTU changes or Blackstone upgrades? I saw a config push this morning touching jumbo frames on the overlay.
Mei (Runtime): I ran quick checks: `ibv_devinfo -v` shows all ports UP but link speed drops to 10G on some nodes. `ethtool -S mlx5_core` shows high TX retries on enp196s0f0.
Sam (ML Infra): Repro: start a 2-node NCCL job with nccl-tests, it hangs after handshake. tcpdump shows ICMP fragmentation messages and ECMP reordering across spine links.
Jordan (Network): ECMP + large UDP RoCE frames + mismatched MTU = reordering/fragmentation. Are we running RoCEv2 (UDP) or native?
Mei (Runtime): We're on RoCEv2 (UDP/IP). I suspect some nodes still using MTU 1500 while others are 9000 after the config push. Also saw `NET_RX_DROP` counters increase.
Alex (SRE): Quick mitigation: cordon affected nodes and schedule queued jobs elsewhere? Can we taint g5 nodes and fallback to g4pool temporarily?
Sam (ML Infra): Tainting now: `kubectl taint nodes g5-*-usw2 problem=rdma:NoSchedule` — will drain a couple of pending jobs. But large model finetunes need G5.
Jordan (Network): I'll roll back the overlay MTU change on the test VLAN and force path pinning for RDMA flows. Also going to enable per-port L3 ECMP hashing to avoid flow distribution causing out-of-order packets.
Mei (Runtime): For troubleshooting: run `ethtool -k enp196s0f0 | grep gro` and disable GRO/GSO on the interface: `ethtool -K enp196s0f0 gro off gso off` — that helped reduce reordering for us previously. Also check `sysctl net.core.rmem_max`/`wmem_max` for buffer sizes.
Alex (SRE): Can someone paste the exact `dmesg` snippet for mlx5 errors? ops-bot, any incident ticket auto-created?
ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-342: "RDMA connectivity causing NCCL hangs on G5 pool (us-west-2)" and paged oncall.
Sam (ML Infra): dmesg excerpt: ```mlx5_core 0000:65:00.0: QP 0x1c2f: send completion timeout, state=ERR
ib_uverbs: driver response timed out
mlx5_core:  mlx5e port 1 link down
```
Jordan (Network): That aligns with RoCE QP stalls from MTU mismatch + fragmented UDP. Next steps: 1) rollback MTU to 1500 on overlay for the affected VLAN, 2) apply flow-affinity ECMP pinning for RoCE UDP ports, 3) coordinate vendor FW roll for mlx5 where link speed drops seen.
Mei (Runtime): I'll add a runtime guard to detect NCCL init hangs and fail-fast with a descriptive error so jobs don't just sit. Also add a preflight check that verifies MTU and `ibv_devinfo` before scheduling multi-node runs.
Alex (SRE): Ops plan: rollback overlay MTU (Jordan), taint/cordon affected nodes (Sam - done), add runtime preflight (Mei), open support case with NIC vendor with logs (Sam).
Jordan (Network): Rolling rollback now on test VLAN; will monitor counters.
Sam (ML Infra): Opened vendor case: CNIC-98765 with Mellanox support, attached dmesg + ethtool output.
Mei (Runtime): Workaround for now: add pod-level `initContainer` that runs:
```
# check MTU
ip link show | grep -A1 enp196s0f0
# check ib
ibv_devinfo -v || exit 1
# disable offloads if needed
ethtool -K enp196s0f0 gro off gso off
```
and fail with readable message if checks fail.
Alex (SRE): After rollback, some nodes report link back to 100Gbps and nccl-tests progressed on 2-node jobs. I'm seeing fewer TX retries.
Jordan (Network): Monitoring ECMP and fragmentation counters. Initial numbers look good but will watch for a couple hours.
Sam (ML Infra): Uncordoning a node to test a real training job; if passes we'll gradually bring capacity back.
Mei (Runtime): Filing a follow-up RFC to standardize MTU and RDMA preflight for all GPU pools to avoid drift.
Alex (SRE): Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread. If anything regresses, escalate to incident and ops-bot will page. :thumbsup:
